content.question: Which statement best captures the difference between BERT's and GPT's pretraining objectives?
options: BERT predicts the next token with causal attention, GPT reconstructs masked tokens
BERT reconstructs masked tokens using bidirectional context, GPT predicts the next token with causal attention
Both use masked language modeling, differing only in model size
BERT is trained without any objective, purely on next-sentence ranking
content.answer: BERT reconstructs masked tokens using bidirectional context, GPT predicts the next token with causal attention
